strings.en:
{1c:13}After my old man died when I was six, I
got raised by a couple, friends of his,{1a}and those two got along real good.{1a}Sounds mean to say it, but I liked
watching the dad and mom there fight.{1a}{0c:5148}They'd holler at each other, throw
whatever was handy, but an hour later
they'd be thick as thieves again.{1a}Even in the middle of a fight, they took
care not to hurt each other with what
they threw,{1a}and even yelling their heads off, you
could tell they were careful about words
a kid like me shouldn't hear...{1a}I ain't got any memories like that of my
real parents, so I envied 'em all the more.
Something fierce.{1a}{0c:5150}They'd go at it straight from the heart,
but they still looked out for each other...{1a}I always figured someday I'd have
something like that with somebody.{0c:fe}
strings.tl: After my old man died when I was six, I got raised by a couple, friends of his, // and those two got along real good. // Sounds mean to say it, but I liked watching the dad and mom there fight. // [1]They'd holler at each other, throw whatever was handy, but an hour later they'd be thick as thieves again. // Even in the middle of a fight, they took care not to hurt each other with what they threw, // and even yelling their heads off, you could tell they were careful about words a kid like me shouldn't hear... // I ain't got any memories like that of my real parents, so I envied 'em all the more. Something fierce. // [2]They'd go at it straight from the heart, but they still looked out for each other... // I always figured someday I'd have something like that with somebody.
